description: This file defines the EmployeeOnLeaveDao class responsible for accessing employee leave data in the database, including methods to retrieve lists and counts of employees currently on leave. It uses Doctrine ORM and includes query building with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

classes.name: EmployeeOnLeaveDao
classes.description: Data access object for employee leave records, providing methods to fetch lists and counts of employees on leave with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: getEmployeeOnLeaveList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of employees on leave based on the provided search filter parameters, returning an array of leave records.

methods.name: getLeaveListPaginator
methods.description: Constructs and returns a paginator object based on the search filter parameters, including filters for leave status, date, employee accessibility, and null check constraints.

methods.name: getEmployeeOnLeaveCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of employees on leave matching the search filter parameters.
